name: Zoey
testimonial:
I have had classes with Ma’am Suegne from Grade 10 up until Grade 11, and I would definitely recommend her classes to anyone who would want to improve their marks or even just get a better understanding of the work.

Her classes are not just like any other classes. She adapts her teaching to the way you learn and process information. When I was struggling, she was always patient and explained things in different ways until they made sense. She always makes complicated concepts so much simpler and more relatable, like using something as basic as baking a cake to explain Chemistry.

Ma’am Suegne is incredibly friendly, kind and easy to connect with, which makes lessons even more enjoyable. She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to understand and succeed.
